note: Journeys, as ordered lists of waypoint ids into locations.json. Language-neutral: the itinerary is rendered per language from each waypoint's own name, so no route prose needs translating. Waypoints whose position cannot be fixed carry precision 'unlocated' in the registry — they appear in the written itinerary but contribute no point to the drawn line, because a guessed pin would be worse than a gap.

sourceNote.ar: ترتيب المحطات كما ورد في الوصف المعتمد لهذه النسخة. ومواضع كثير منها تقريبية أو غير محددة بدقة.
sourceNote.en: The order of stages is as given in the itinerary adopted for this edition. Many of the positions are approximate, and several cannot be fixed at all.
sourceNote.de: Die Reihenfolge der Stationen folgt der für diese Ausgabe übernommenen Route. Viele Positionen sind ungefähr, mehrere lassen sich gar nicht bestimmen.
